_about: Playlist (*.playlist.json) fields. Source: https://projectreclaimer.dev/host 'Playlist file reference', 'Custom vote images', 'Sprint in a playlist'.

header.label: Vote time
header.help: How long each ballot stays open.

entry.label: Entry name
entry.help: The name players see for this game.

entry.label: Weight
entry.help: How often ballots offer this game compared with the others.

entry.label: Vote image
entry.help: A PNG or JPEG in the server's content/Images (file name only, at most 4 MiB) shown in the vote instead of the map's artwork. Up to 32 different images per playlist.

entry.label: Disable anti-cheat for this game
entry.help: For maps or game types with unusual physics or scripts. An entry can only turn anti-cheat off.

entry.label: Team voice only
entry.help: Keeps voice to teammates while this game plays: V is silent, B reaches teammates and N only nearby teammates. Can't turn on voice the server has off.

world.label: Sprint
world.help: Off for every playlist game unless its entry turns it on, even when the map or game type has sprint.

world.label: Stamina
world.help: With Stamina sprint: how long a full meter lasts. 5 seconds when left out.
